T-LOG 2026.08.10 [EN]

Log: 2026-08-10 18:44

System in the cash session (Spot) mode. The NDX Star shows an oversold state (CVD: -60,25M), while the NQ Probe oscillates around the 29736.50 level, passing through a demand test phase (CVD: -7,55K). The QQQ Satellite also reports a demand test (CVD: -583,49K). In the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) zone, volatility (IV) is 20.48%. Intense volume exchange was noted in the HVN 29740 - 29760 barrier zone, where multiple breaches of support and resistance levels occurred. The wide TICKQ Exchange is in a state of market collapse (-358.00), which is a significant deviation from the SMA200 average (131.68), indicating a market surge. Average Action is [BRAK_DANYCH_W_TELEMETRII]. The Q-Score market vector is -18 (probability 41%), and the radiation trend is decreasing (-3.80). There is a clear stratification of the system: despite demand tests on instruments, the Background Radiation (TICKQ) and the market vector suggest strong selling pressure.
